description: Shell library for testing credential helpers, including functions for checking, approving, rejecting, and cleaning credentials, as well as testing various credential helper behaviors and capabilities.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Function to test credential helper with provided input and compare output.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads lines from input until '--' is encountered, outputs lines read.

methods.name: helper_test_clean
methods.description: Cleans residual data from previous tests for various credential scenarios.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects specific credentials for a given helper.

methods.name: helper_test
methods.description: Runs a series of tests on a specified credential helper, including storing, retrieving, overwriting, and deleting credentials, as well as handling long headers and timeouts.

methods.name: helper_test_password_expiry_utc
methods.description: Tests storing, retrieving, and overwriting password expiry times.

methods.name: helper_test_oauth_refresh_token
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving OAuth refresh tokens.

methods.name: helper_test_authtype
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving authtype and credential information.
